classification.per_asset: COST_ROBUST if >=2 EDGE lookbacks; COST_FRAGILE if 1; COST_ERASED if 0
classification.per_lookback: EDGE if REGIME_STABLE and all medians > 0; LOSS if REGIME_STABLE_LOSS; else NO_EDGE
classification.universe: PERSISTS if all zero-cost COST_ROBUST assets stay COST_ROBUST; PARTIAL if a non-empty subset; ERASED if none
